title: MDPI revives Open Access Journal of Italian Medical Laboratory
desc: MDPI, the Open Access publisher, today announced it has successfully acquired and relaunched the Journal of Interdisciplinary Research Applied to Medicine (JDReAM). Dormant since 2021, MDPI published its first issue of JDReAM in March, with Volume 6, Issue 3 anticipated this month. The new collaboration between JDReAM and MDPI reflects ongoing demand for quality OA publishing services in Italy, bolstered by active support from the region’s academic community. In 2025, more than 68% of research outputs in Italy were published in OA, accounting for more than 124,300 papers.
